title: Does It Need a Closer Look?
banner: Give the answer the attention it deserves.

cards.heading: What Kind of Task Is It?
cards.body: A factual answer needs accurate information. A draft needs clear writing. A plan needs to work. Check what matters for the task.

cards.heading: How Much Is Riding on It?
cards.body: A movie pick is low stakes. A scholarship application or advice about an injury deserves more care. What happens if the answer is wrong?

title: Take a Closer Look

cards.heading: Check the Sources
cards.body: Ask for sources, then open them. Does each source support the claim? Is it reliable? For current information, ask AI to search the web.

cards.heading: Challenge the Answer
cards.body: Ask, “What’s the strongest argument against this?” or “What important information did you leave out?” Decide whether it changes your view of the answer.

cards.heading: Check It Yourself
cards.body: Find another way to check the answer. Recalculate the numbers, test the code, or ask someone who knows the subject.

transition.heading: WAYS TO TAKE A CLOSER LOOK

connector: The more that depends on the answer, the more carefully you should check it.

cards.heading: Use It
cards.body: The answer is right and good enough for what you need.

cards.heading: Fix It
cards.body: Tell AI what needs to change, or change it yourself. Then check the revised answer before you use it.

cards.heading: Walk Away
cards.body: If AI isn’t helping you get there, try another approach or ask someone who knows the subject.
